seed: A walk that drives the app was said to be unable to make a measurement at all: pick up the ruler, click the two points a person would click, and nothing appears. The report was half right. A Distance caliper takes THREE clicks, not two: one on each end, then one more to park the number. Two clicks leave a caliper half placed, and the log used to show an empty list with no word about why. This walk makes a measurement the right way on a blank canvas AND on an opened screenshot, and in between it stops after two clicks on purpose so the log says out loud what the caliper is still waiting for.

steps.note: THE SETUP: a blank 900x600 canvas with one drawn rectangle, the ruler in Distance mode. Use the measureMode step, never a bare I: pressing I when Measure is already up cycles the MODE instead of arming it, and that alone is enough to make a walk measure nothing
THE FIRST CLAIM: two clicks leave nothing on the picture ON PURPOSE, and the log now says why: measuring reads "both feet are down, waiting for a click to park the number"
THE SECOND CLAIM: the third click parks the number and the caliper lands. measures names it: Width = 200 px. The dock has grown a Measurements section
THE THIRD CLAIM: the same three clicks on an opened screenshot measure the Save Changes button, so this is not a blank-canvas trick. measures names the reading
